institution: California Northstate University College of Dental Medicine
otherConditions: Minimum of 90 semester credits or 135 quarter credits required from an accredited US or Canadian college (or equivalent foreign institution); baccalaureate degree preferred. Minimum science and total GPA of 2.80 (3.20 preferred).

institution: Pacific Northwest University of Health Science School of Dental Medicine
otherConditions: All prerequisite courses must be lecture-based (labs alone do not count), completed within 7 years of matriculation, and finished by spring of the enrollment year. Overall GPA minimum 2.85; prerequisite GPA minimum 3.0. No more than 3 prerequisite courses may be in progress/outstanding at application. DAT not required.

courses.name: General Biochemistry
courses.details: One of five secondary-requirement options; applicants choose from Biochemistry, Microbiology, Physics, English, or Social/Behavioral Science.

institution: Herman Ostrow School of Dentistry of the University of Southern California
otherConditions: Minimum of 60 semester units with a grade of C or better must be completed or in progress at time of application. Coursework must be from a US or Canadian accredited institution; accelerated science programs not accepted; hybrid courses allowed but lab components must be in person. DAT required, taken within 3 years of admission year sought.

institution: The Dental College of Georgia at Augusta University
otherConditions: Minimum 90 semester hours (135 quarter hours) required at an accredited American college or university, with preference for a completed baccalaureate degree. All required courses must use a graduated grading scale (A-F), not pass/fail. Grade of C or better required in all required courses.

courses.name: Principles of Biology
courses.details: One academic year (two semesters, or three quarters, or one semester and two quarters).

courses.name: Organic Chemistry I
courses.details: Part of the required academic year of advanced chemistry.

courses.name: Biochemistry I
courses.details: Part of the required academic year of advanced chemistry; lab optional.

courses.name: English
